h1: H-frame hydraulic presses — H-frame and four-column production presses, 22 to 661 US tons
intro: An H-frame (straight-side) hydraulic press carries the cylinder in a crown between two side frames, so the frame stays square under load and takes the largest tables and tonnages — the press for dies: forming, blanking, coining, deep drawing and composite moulding, cycle after cycle. A four-column press does the same on four guide posts, open to the die from every side. NovoTech sells two lines in Canada, all on this page, small to large: the premium line, built in Turkey — the AT presses with T-slot tables for your own dies and the AP garage-type press brake for 1/4″ and 3/8″ plate, 110 to 165 US tons; the HDT Eco H-frame to 276 US tons; and the production presses on a welded, machined monoblock frame with Siemens PLC, HMI touchscreen and light barriers — HSA single action, HDD double action deep drawing with a die cushion, SMC / HHRP hot plate presses and HCFP four-column presses, 110 to 661 US tons as standard, the H-frames to 3,307 US tons and the HCFP to 1,102 US tons to order; and the value line, built in China — HP-M1 presses whose table slides out of the frame, HPB presses with a brake function, HP H-frame presses from 33 to 551 US tons and HP-F four-column presses to 347 US tons, the F1/PLC models with a touchscreen. Each family below has its full specification table and photos. Parts, installation and service from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

hero_brand_line: The premium-line presses are built in Turkey with European components; the value-line presses are built in China — all to NovoTech's specification and sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.

faq.a: A shop press is operated by hand — joystick or two-hand buttons — for one part at a time: pressing, straightening, bending. A production press runs a die under PLC control with programmed speeds, pressures, dwell and return, light barriers instead of guards, automatic lubrication and remote diagnostics, for thousands of cycles a shift. The NovoTech premium line starts at 33 US tons with the CFS C-frame and goes to 3,307 US tons on the H-frame presses.

faq.q: Single action or double action — what is a die cushion?
faq.a: A single action press has one ram. A double action (deep drawing) press adds a die cushion in the lower table — a second cylinder that holds the blank holder with its own programmed force — so a flat blank can be drawn into a deep cup, pan or housing without wrinkling. The HDD H-frame and CFDD C-frame presses have the cushion built in; it is an option on the HCFP column press.

An H-frame press is the stiffest for its size and takes the widest tables — the choice for deep drawing, long dies and the largest tonnages. A four-column press guides the slide on four posts and is open to the die from all four sides, which suits automation, die loading from the side and parts that overhang the table. The HCFP and HP-F are four-column presses; the HSA, HDD, HHRP, HDT and HP are H-frames.

The AP garage-type press brake is a hydraulic press delivered with a 5-face prism bottom die and hardened top blade for bending 1/4″ (110 US tons) or 3/8″ (165 US tons) mild steel over 40″ or 60″ — the economical way to bend brackets and short plate without a full press brake. The value-line HPB presses are set up the same way, with replaceable top tools, a V-block and a support table with stops; the twin-cylinder D models bend widths of 47 – 71″. The AT press has T-slot tables for bolting your own forming, blanking and coining dies.

faq.q: Can the press be built to my die?
faq.a: Yes — every series of the premium line is built to order in the table size, stroke, daylight and tonnage the die needs, from a 33 US ton C-frame to a 3,307 US ton H-frame, with quick die change, die loading arms, ejector, heated platens or a die cushion as required. Send us the die drawing and the cycle you need and we quote the press around it.

The premium-line shop and production presses are built in Turkey with European hydraulics and Siemens controls, for daily production work, straightening lines and custom sizes. The value-line presses are built in China for the repair shop, the maintenance department and lighter production — the same tonnages at a lower price, with built-on or separate power units.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase. Manual machines have no electrics.
